# Minnie Park

> Minnie Park is a Korean interactive audio-visual artist working between Seoul and Melbourne. Her research-led practice uses living roses, touch, colour, sound, moving image and audience participation to examine affect, culturally situated emotion, ambivalence and relation.

This is the canonical artist portfolio for Minnie Park. Meta Rose is her central ongoing body of work, begun in 2024. Each chapter develops a distinct installation and audio-visual system while returning to the rose, pink and touch as a recurring artistic grammar.

## Primary pages

- [Artist](https://minniepark.art/artist/): Artist statement, biography and selected history.
- [Works](https://minniepark.art/works/): Selected installations, collaborations and the Meta Rose body of work.
- [Visual Index](https://minniepark.art/visual-index/): Chronological visual record of installations, generated images, material studies and participation.
- [Research](https://minniepark.art/research/): The 2025 Honours research and The Meta Kibun Project.
- [Contact](https://minniepark.art/contact/): Exhibition, curatorial, research, talk and artistic collaboration enquiries.
- [Artist CV](https://minniepark.art/cv/): Artist CV and downloadable PDF.
